about: Static index built from the public pages of this site. Nothing private.

entries.title: Who is Jhapendra Kandel
entries.text: Jhapendra Kandel (J.K) is a full-stack developer, cybersecurity enthusiast and automation engineer based in Kathmandu, Nepal. He is working towards a Bachelor of Information Technology. He builds secure, scalable web applications, from custom WordPress platforms and news portals to REST APIs and self-hosted infrastructure, and keeps security part of the work from the start. He is available for work.

entries.title: Motto
entries.text: Build with precision, secure by design, automate with purpose. The homepage line is: I build it. Then I break it.

entries.title: Focus areas
entries.text: Focus areas: ethical hacking and penetration testing; network security and secure software development; DevOps and infrastructure automation; applied AI, LLM systems and workflow automation.

entries.title: Currently learning
entries.text: Currently learning: advanced LLM fine-tuning, RAG pipelines, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and container orchestration.

entries.title: Education
entries.text: Bachelor of Information Technology (BIT), in progress. Undergraduate study across software engineering, networking, cybersecurity, databases, operating systems and modern web technologies.

entries.title: Certifications
entries.text: Certifications, all 2025: GitHub Foundations (GitHub), Google Cloud Computing Foundations (Google Cloud) and Cloudflare Fundamentals (Cloudflare).

entries.title: Competitions
entries.text: Hack Astra CTF run by The Hackers Community Nepal: ranked 80th of 450 players. Also took part in the Nutanix Capture The Flag and a Digital Forensics Hackathon.

entries.title: Nepali news site (solo build)
entries.text: Built a full Nepali news site alone from scratch: front end, back end, and all the server work and DevOps to deploy it and keep it running. Stack: WordPress, PHP, DevOps and automation. Featured, public project.

entries.title: Nepali text to speech
entries.text: Trained a speech model that reads Nepali out loud, so Nepali text can be turned into natural-sounding audio. Python, PyTorch, speech. Featured AI and machine learning project, private.

entries.title: Nepali LLM at home
entries.text: A language model built for Nepali, trained and served entirely on a homelab machine with a 32 GB GPU. LLM, fine-tuning, homelab. Featured AI project, private.

entries.title: Honeypot Lab
entries.text: Fire attacks at a decoy in your browser, watch them get classified, work the cases in a management portal, then see each weakness fixed and retested. Security and detection, runs in the page. A public demo.

entries.title: NetGuard DNS Monitor
entries.text: Real-time DNS monitoring and threat detection that flags suspicious lookups as they happen. Python, networking, security. Public cybersecurity tool on GitHub.

entries.title: ONSS (notes sharing)
entries.text: ONSS, the Online Notes Sharing System: upload, browse and download study notes with user accounts. PHP, MySQL, Bootstrap. A public web application.

entries.title: Video Reel Generator
entries.text: A model that takes a topic or a short script and builds a vertical video reel from it, adding cuts and captions on its own. Python, video, generative AI. Private.

entries.title: Voice to Text Model
entries.text: A speech recognition model that listens to spoken audio and writes out what was said. Python, ASR, audio. Private.

entries.title: Kandel Holdings
entries.text: Property and bill management platform with real-time updates for tenants and owners. PHP, MySQL, real-time. Private web app.

entries.title: Restaurant Management System
entries.text: Order and invoice management that keeps table orders, billing and kitchen tickets in one dashboard. PHP, MySQL, JavaScript. Private.

entries.title: Notes Sharing Platform
entries.text: Collaborative learning platform with note uploads, browsing and real-time chat between students. PHP, MySQL, WebSockets. Private.

entries.title: Techkart
entries.text: A full shopping website with a catalogue, cart and checkout flow on a PHP and SQL backend. PHP, SQL, JavaScript. E-commerce, private.

entries.title: Skills (self-rated out of 100)
entries.text: Self-rated skills out of 100: HTML5 92, CSS3 90, WordPress 90, PHP 88, JavaScript 85, MySQL 85, React 82, Python 80, Linux and server admin 78, Docker 75, ethical hacking and penetration testing 70. The ratings are the owner's own, not a test result.

entries.title: How it started
entries.text: Started by building small websites in school and never stopped. Along the way interest grew in how systems break, so now building and securing go together, with safety from the first line of code.

entries.title: Learning the whole stack
entries.text: Picked up the stack piece by piece: C and Python first, then databases and Node on the server, then React on the front end. Now comfortable across all of it on the same project.

entries.title: Getting into security
entries.text: Spends time on ethical hacking, network security and penetration testing. Understanding how something can be attacked makes for better building. Treats every input as untrusted.

entries.title: Shipping real products
entries.text: Products run in production: a property and billing platform, a restaurant order and invoice system, a notes app with live chat, and a DNS monitor that watches for bad lookups.

entries.title: Self-hosting and homelab
entries.text: Self-hosts an Ubuntu server on an Orange Pi Zero 2W at home, and runs a homelab machine with a 32 GB GPU for model training. Sets up the Docker containers, the web server and the database personally.

entries.title: What he is on now
entries.text: Right now spending time on training and running language models, Nepali speech models, RAG pipelines and container orchestration.

entries.title: Contact
entries.text: Email jhapendrakandel.mac@gmail.com, or use the contact form on the homepage. Also on GitHub (jhapendra-kandel), LinkedIn (jhapendrakandel), YouTube (@Kandeljhapendra) and Instagram (jk.jk_100). Open to work and to building things that stay up.
